financing_relationships.boundary: Federal outlays and recipient revenue differ in perimeter, timing, pass-through, and classification.

financing_relationships.relationship: program and grant outlays coexist with credit subsidy, negative subsidy, downward reestimate, repayment, collection, liquidating-account, and offsetting-receipt entries
financing_relationships.boundary: The negative net value is a credit-account result and is not cash collections, waste, or savings.

financing_relationships.boundary: Program outcome cohorts and actual-outlay allocation remain unmatched.

financing_relationships.relationship: account-specific discretionary or mandatory authorities and grants remain to be mapped
financing_relationships.boundary: No blanket general-fund, grant, fee, or offset allocation is inferred.

financing_relationships.relationship: account-specific labor-service appropriations, fees, recoveries, or offsets remain to be mapped
financing_relationships.boundary: No account-level financing split is admitted.

financing_relationships.relationship: federal grants and program outlays remain distinct from state/local matching or service-delivery resources

public_warning: EDU-A-03 separates appropriations, grants, nongrants, mandatory and discretionary outlays, credit subsidy, negative subsidy, reestimates, collections, offsets, and recipient-side state/local finance. Known FY2025 bridges are retained with their signs; unresolved account allocations, cash/subsidy equivalence, state/local translation, rates, solver input, EDU-A closure, and EDU-B start remain blocked.
